templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Choose a professional template for your resume
templates.boldKeywords: Bold important keywords in DOCX exports
templates.noResumeWarning: This is a preview. Upload your resume to see your data.

export.arabicLayout: Arabic PDFs use DejaVu Sans with template colors, emphasis and spacing. Copied text may include standard text direction marks.
export.styledUnsupported: This Arabic PDF could not preserve every character safely. Choose DOCX or review the Text PDF layout.
export.failed: Export failed. Please try again, or switch to the ATS-friendly template and retry.
export.timeout: Export is taking unusually long — bring this browser tab into focus (some browsers pause rendering work in background tabs) and try again.
export.busy: The PDF renderer was busy. Wait a few seconds and press Download again.
export.reviewRequired: Review the highlighted changes before downloading.
export.legacyBody: The original resume is unavailable. Check the entire visible document before downloading.
export.unverified: Selectable text could not be verified. Review this PDF before using it.
export.textPreviewDescription: This is a different plain layout with one left margin. Arabic and Latin text or links may use separate rows. Review every fact and link before downloading; the PDF must still pass the text check. This does not guarantee ATS compatibility.
export.textLimits: Some combined Arabic marks, compatibility ligatures, unsupported scripts and ASCII hyphens before Arabic-Indic or Eastern Arabic digits (including negative values, ranges and dates) cannot be rendered safely. Other export options remain available.
export.textUnsupported: Text PDF cannot safely render this content. Combined Arabic marks, compatibility ligatures, unsupported scripts or ASCII hyphens before Arabic-Indic or Eastern Arabic digits may need another export option.
export.textUnavailable: Text PDF is temporarily unavailable. Try again or choose another export option.
export.textUnverified: Text PDF did not pass the text check. Choose another export option.
export.imageWarning: Image-only PDF — text cannot be selected; some systems may need OCR.
